clarification_questions.question: What does the liquid look like at the measurement point?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: Which method is recommended first (Clear liquid: primary method → NIR; adds UV-Vis transmission or transflection probe to the shortlist; Turbid or cloudy: adds risk: a turbid or changing liquid (probe geometries to compare); Opaque, such as milky or dense: adds UV-Vis ATR probe to the shortlist; drops NIR transmission or transflection probe from the shortlist)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The optical character decides between transmission, transflection and reflection or ATR geometries.

clarification_questions.question: Which industry or application area is this process for?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: Which method is recommended first (Dairy or food: primary method → NIR; adds NIR diffuse reflection probe to the shortlist; Bioprocess or fermentation: primary method → NIR; adds UV-Vis ATR probe to the shortlist)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Published applications of the same area weigh most when the methods are ranked.

clarification_questions.question: Is there a reference method that provides comparison values?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, a laboratory method: plan: calibrate against it and state its own error; No, none yet: plan: a reference measurement campaign comes first)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Models can only be as good as the reference values they are built on.

clarification_questions.question: Do you already have numerical acceptance criteria, such as required accuracy or a detection limit?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, they are defined: plan: test against the agreed criteria; Not yet: plan: agree numerical criteria before the test)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Without them the experiment has no go or no-go criterion.

clarification_questions.question: Over what range would the target variable need to be monitored once defined?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Narrow, around a set point: plan: sample around the set point; Wide, from low to high: plan: sample the full range)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The range decides whether the sensitivity of a method can be enough.

clarification_questions.question: How quickly must a result be available?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Real time, within seconds: plan: a short link and fast sampling; Hours are fine: plan: at-line sampling may be enough)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The response time limits the measurement and sampling set-up.

rationale.text: For samples of incompletely known composition, testing several optical methods supports selection of the most suitable method or combination.

feasibility_plan.objective: Test whether spectroscopy can distinguish representative good and off-specification samples in relation to a defined quality variable.
clarify_first: What does the liquid look like at the measurement point?
Which industry or application area is this for?

samples_and_states.text: Collect representative retained good and off-specification samples spanning relevant process states.

reference_measurements.text: Obtain matched reference measurements once the quality variable and a suitable reference method have been defined.

setup.text: Record MIR, NIR and Raman spectra on the same retained sample set using screening arrangements rather than a final in-line configuration.

comparison.text: Compare the methods for differences between good and off-specification samples that relate to the reference measurements.

validation.text: Test any screening-derived relationship on independent material excluded from method selection and calibration.

go_no_go.text: Treat an unresolved target definition or failure to meet pre-agreed acceptance criteria as no-go for configuration selection.

not_demonstrated.text: The suitability of an exact in-line sensor configuration remains un demonstrated.

steps: Clarify the measurement task and agree acceptance criteria.
Collect representative retained good and off-specification samples.
Record and compare MIR, NIR and Raman spectra.
Validate candidate relationships on independent material.
Decide go or no-go against the agreed criteria.

decision_basis.text: Decide whether to advance by comparing results on independent material against client-agreed criteria established before testing.
